name: com.mindpolling/mindpolling
title: Mind Polling
description: Polls of AI models: read public results with no key; sign in to create and run your own.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer mp_live_..., for a client that cannot sign in with OAuth; public polls need none.

environmentVariables.name: MIND_POLLING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Mind Polling API key, for your own polls; or run `npx mindpolling login` once instead. Without either: public polls.
